components.name: AccentBar
components.summary: A thin 3px progress line filled with the signature gradient, available as the React `AccentBar` and as `.cr-accentbar` classes.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: The FAQ accordion: rounded, bordered rows built on native `<details>`/`<summary>` that open in place with a plus that turns to a cross.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline status banners (info, success, warning, error) that sit in the page flow, plus the dismissible dark announcement bar that sits above the header.

components.name: AnchorNav
components.summary: In-page links for long pages: a sticky "On this page" list beside the content on desktop, and a horizontal sticky anchor bar under the header for product pages and phones.

components.name: AppBanner
components.summary: Promotes the dot.Bible app in three sizes: a dismissible "Open in app" smart banner on mobile, an inline promo card with QR and store badges on desktop, and a slim strip at the end of an article.

components.name: AppBar
components.summary: The top bar of a mobile app screen: status bar, a 56px row with back, title and icon actions, and an optional large title or search field.

components.name: AppHomeScreen
components.summary: The composed dot.Bible home screen, built only from App UI parts: app bar with the dot.Bible mark, search, continue-reading card, grouped language rows, mini player and tab bar.

components.name: AudioPlayer
components.summary: The audio Bible player: a full player with cover, seek bar, speed and transport controls, and a docked mini player in light and dark.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A circular picture of a person or partner, shown as a photo, initials or a person icon, with an optional status dot and an overlapping group stack.

components.name: BackToTop
components.summary: A 48px round button fixed at the bottom-right of long pages that scrolls back to the top and returns focus to the start of the content.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small pill labels: the React `Badge` section tag in an outlined pill, `.badge` status badges, removable `.cr-tag` filters and the `.count` number dot.

components.name: BibleCard
components.summary: A black-leather Bible cover with a gold tooled border that presents one language's Bible: native name, dot.bible address, Read / Listen / Order / Get the app tiles and a QR share, plus a compact row for lists.

components.name: BookPicker
components.summary: The book, chapter and verse chooser that opens from the reader's "John 3 ⌄" button: a two-pane panel on desktop and a bottom sheet with steps on mobile.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: A panel that slides up from the bottom of an app screen for sharing and quick options, plus the iOS-style action sheet for a short list of commands with Cancel.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: A one-line trail under the hero of interior ism.bible pages that shows where the page sits and links back up each level.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped call-to-action button used across ISM's app, site, and print/email creative, available as the React `Button` and as `.btn` classes.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Rounded content containers: the React `Card` (a large, image-led tile) and the website `.card` family for programs, text, values, people, contact, books, steps and statements.

components.name: CenteredCta
components.summary: Light, centred call to action (eyebrow, headline, two buttons) in a white card, plus a compact inline banner card for one question and one action.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A 20px checkbox with 6px corners for single yes/no choices, and full-width `.check` row cards for choosing several options from a short list.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A pill toggle (`.chip` with `aria-pressed`) for filtering a list or picking a preset value such as a gift amount.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: A search field joined to a dropdown list: type to filter a long list, or press the caret to see every option, in a 48px form size and a 64px homepage hero size.

components.name: CookieBanner
components.summary: A small charcoal card at the bottom-left of ism.bible that asks for cookie consent on the first visit, with Accept All and Reject Non-Essential.

components.name: CtaBand
components.summary: Dark `.sec-ink` closing band with a centred eyebrow, headline and two buttons above three numbered columns of ways to take part.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: A text field with a calendar button inside it that opens a 352px month popover for picking a single future date.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.summary: Key-value rows for order and giving details, plus a stacked definition list for glossaries.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Separates content: the React `Divider` gradient accent, the `.thread` signature line, and quiet `.cr-rule` hairlines (strong, labelled "or", vertical).

components.name: DonationWidget
components.summary: The giving module: one-time or monthly switch, preset amount chips with Other, a live impact line, one Give button and a secure note, plus compact and goal-progress versions.

components.name: DownloadState
components.summary: Offline and download indicators for ISM apps: the 44px download button in its four states, a storage usage row, and offline / back-online banners.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: A centred panel that explains why a list, search or screen has nothing to show and offers the one next step.

components.name: EventCard
components.summary: Two sibling cards for what is happening at ISM: an event card with a date tile, type badge, time and place, and a news card with a photo, category badge, date and Read the story link.

components.name: Eyebrow
components.summary: Small uppercase section labels: the `.eyebrow` in a thin blue rectangle that introduces a headline, and the quieter `.overline` that heads a list, menu or table.

components.name: Fab
components.summary: The floating + button for a screen's one main create action, with the pull-to-refresh indicator and the snackbar that sits above the tab bar.

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: A dashed drop zone with a "browse" link over a real file input, followed by a list of file rows that show upload progress, success or a plain-language error.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The site-wide black footer for ism.bible: a gradient-bordered giving banner, the full ISM logo with tagline and socials, three link columns and a legal line.

components.name: FormLayout
components.summary: The frame for longer ISM forms: fieldsets with a legend column on the left and two-column fields on the right, required/optional marking, character counters, and a validation summary that links to each error.

components.name: Hero
components.summary: The dark, centred home-page hero: gradient photo under a dark overlay, eyebrow, H1 with one emphasised word, lead, two buttons and language chips.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A round, icon-only button (`.iconbtn`) for compact actions such as menu, search, close, share and play.

components.name: Iconography
components.summary: Two icon sets: filled ministry icons for features and illustrations, and a thin line set for interface controls, plus the direction rule for carets and arrows.

components.name: InlineSubscribe
components.summary: A single-row newsletter sign-up: a 52px pill email field and a Subscribe pill button that wrap onto two lines on narrow screens, for light and dark sections.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Rounded 48px text field with its label above, available as the React `Input` and as `.field` › `.label` + `.input` with hint, error and success messages.

components.name: LanguageRow
components.summary: A language entry in the dot.bible directory: native-script name first, English name second, format badges (Read, Listen, Print, App) and a ↗, as a list row or as a card.

components.name: LanguageSwitcher
components.summary: Lets people read ism.bible in their own language: a globe "EN ⌄" button in the header opens a searchable list of language names in their own script, with a full-screen sheet on phones and an inline row in the footer.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Text links for navigation: plain inline links in copy, the `.lnk` underline-reveal link, and the ghost "see all" link with ↗.

components.name: ListRow
components.summary: A 56px row of icon or avatar, title, meta and an end slot, grouped as a divided list or inset card, plus the React `ListRow` audio row with progress and play.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: Spinners for short waits, a busy state for buttons, and shimmering skeletons that hold the shape of content while it loads.

components.name: Logos
components.summary: The ISM and dot.Bible logos, marks and brand patterns, with the rules for placing them on light and dark surfaces.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: A white dialog over a dimmed scrim that holds one short task or one decision, including the confirmation dialog for destructive and neutral choices.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: A tag input that grows from 48px, holds removable chips for each pick, and opens a type-to-filter list with checkboxes that stays open while picking.

components.name: NetworkMap
components.summary: An abstract dot map of the Global Bible Network with a legend, gold partner-hub pins and a tooltip, beside a selectable list of regions with partner counts.

components.name: NewsletterCard
components.summary: A dark email sign-up card with an eyebrow, headline, one email field and a full-width Subscribe button, which turns into a one-line confirmation after sign-up.

components.name: NumberedList
components.summary: Ordered content in two forms: large numbered rows (01, 02) for programmes and beliefs, and compact numbered steps (1, 2) for how-it-works instructions.

components.name: PageIntro
components.summary: The opening block of an inner page (eyebrow, headline, lead) and the matching section heading row with an eyebrow, h2 and a ghost "See all" link.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Moves through a long list split into pages (news, resources, partner lists): numbered pages with Previous / Next, a compact "Page 3 of 12" form, or a Load more button.

components.name: PartnerCard
components.summary: A linked card for one ISM partner: an initials tile, name, location, partner-type badges and a ↗ that fills black on hover.

components.name: PhoneInput
components.summary: One 48px field that joins a country-code button and a number input, with a searchable country list that opens 6px below.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Bars and rings that show how far along a task is, from a file download to day 15 of a reading plan to step 1 of 2 in a sign-up.

components.name: QrShare
components.summary: A QR code beside a short prompt with Copy link and Share buttons, so someone can pass a dot.bible link to a person standing next to them.

components.name: Quote
components.summary: Three quotation blocks: a large Lora pull quote, a testimonial card with avatar, and a scripture quote with a gold rule, verse numbers and a full reference.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: A 20px radio button with a 6px Horizon Blue ring when selected, used in a fieldset group where exactly one option can be picked.

components.name: ReadingView
components.summary: The chapter reader: a sticky bar with book and translation pickers, text size and listen, over a single serif column with verse numbers, section headings, highlights and footnotes.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: A 48px search input with a magnifier on the left and a round clear button that appears once there is text.

components.name: SearchResults
components.summary: The in-app search screen: focused field with Cancel, recent searches, results grouped by type with highlighted matches, and a helpful no-results state.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A pill-shaped two-option toggle, like One-time / Monthly on Give Online, where the chosen half fills charcoal (white on dark).

components.name: Select
components.summary: A field-styled dropdown button with a caret that opens a short listbox of fixed options 6px below the field.

components.name: SettingsRow
components.summary: Grouped inset settings for ISM apps: section headers, inset cards of 52px rows with toggles, values with ›, radio choices, a separate Sign out card and helper text.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.summary: The site-wide black header bar for ism.bible: ISM mark, five main links (three open submenus), a white Give pill and a menu button that opens the mobile drawer.

components.name: SkipLink
components.summary: The first focusable element on every page: an off-screen "Skip to content" link that appears as a white pill over the header on the first Tab press and jumps keyboard users past the navigation.

components.name: SplitSection
components.summary: Two-column section with a photo on one side and eyebrow, headline, lead and actions on the other; image-left/text-right by default, reversible.

components.name: StatTile
components.summary: A metric tile with one big number, a short label, an optional up or down change and an optional sparkline, on light or dark.

components.name: StationCard
components.summary: A partner radio station card: photo, call sign and frequency, an On air or Off air pill, city and languages, what is playing now, and one action.

components.name: StoreBadges
components.summary: Black App Store and Google Play download badges for the dot.Bible app, in two sizes, for light and dark sections, with an optional QR for desktop.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A 46 × 28px toggle switch for settings that take effect at once, shown in a 44px row with a title and a one-line description.

components.name: TabBar
components.summary: The bottom tab bar of an ISM app: five equal tabs (Home, Bible, Listen, Saved, More) that switch between the app's top-level sections.

components.name: Table
components.summary: A data table for admin and report screens, with sortable headers, row selection, status badges, a row menu, zebra and dense variants, and a stacked-card layout on mobile.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between panels of related content on the same page without a page load: underline tabs with counts, pill segmented tabs, vertical tabs and a scrollable mobile row.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short dark message that confirms an action or reports a quiet failure, then hides itself, with at most one action such as Undo or Retry.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A small dark label that names an icon-only control on hover or focus, and its light popover sibling that opens on click to explain something with a title and one link.

components.name: VerseBlock
components.summary: A single Bible verse set in Lora with its reference and Share, Copy and Bookmark tools, plus a dark Verse of the Day hero and an inline citation link.

components.name: VideoPlayer
components.summary: A 16:9 video frame: a poster with a large white play button, caption and duration chips, and while playing a bottom control bar with seek, time, captions, settings and full screen.
